content.text:
The image shows bisacodyl. A central CH carbon carries a pyridin-2-yl group and two 4-acetoxyphenyl groups.

- **Pyridine:** the ring nitrogen is adjacent to the carbon bonded to the central CH, so the attachment is at the 2-position.
- **Phenyl rings:** each is para-substituted, with the central CH at one end and an O–C(=O)CH3 acetate at the other.

SMILES: CC(=O)Oc1ccc(cc1)C(c1ccccn1)c1ccc(OC(C)=O)cc1
